title: Alef WebGL Game
fullDescription: An educational quest game developed in WebGL for Alef University. The game leverages immersive third-person gameplay to raise awareness about climate change, attracting over 11,000 users. It combines interactive storytelling with a rich visual experience to engage and educate players.
